name: Extract RepoCli.Core shared library
description:
Move RepoLocator, Git, GitIdentity, Interaction, ExitCodes, GlobalSettings, JSON output conventions and the generic part of PluginGenerator into a RepoCli.Core project referenced by both tools.
Packed into each tool's package; no separate NuGet package. Exit codes, --json, --root and non-interactive rules stay identical across tools.
author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>

comments.author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>
comments.text: RepoCli.Core holds Cli/ (ExitCodes, UsageException/NotFoundException, GlobalSettings, Interaction, EnumOptionConverter, CliOutput, RepoCliApp.Configure, Plugin/ generic generator + GeneratePluginCommand<TPlugin : IPluginSource>) and Features/ (Repo: RepoLocator incl. .repo-docs marker, Git, GitIdentity, FolderLock; Json: RepoJson; Validation: Severity). Tests in RepoCli.Core.Tests. Exit code 3 is now 'referenced item not found'. ISSUES_NONINTERACTIVE or DOCS_NONINTERACTIVE disables prompts in both tools.
